newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent turns lower by close, bears push lower.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent turns lower by close, bears push lower.

text.p: Crude futures on Simex turned lower by the close after being firmer earlier in the day as gas oil futures came under pressure in London.
February Brent was last traded at $23.40 per barrel, down eight cents from London, while March shed nine cents to $23.05.
NYMEX February crude tracked the trend and was last traded at $25.10, down nine cents from New York.
Brokers said the market lost any support from a modest rebound in Asia time after London opened.

A report from the International Energy Agency (IEA), showing world oil production rose 1.3 million barrels per day (bpd) in December, added to the bearish tone. The IEA revised down its expectations for first quarter demand by 200,000 bpd.
In addition, brokers said the markets might look to shake out further long positions before focusing on the API stock data due later in the global day.
